title: Accounts Receivable Associate - NAM
jobDescription:

They provide support to our Clients, Program Offices and Suppliers by leveraging our tools and best practices. title: Senior Manager - Technology
jobDescription:
Role Summary:

With technology offerings constantly changing, it can be difficult for senior managers to understand how effective the latest innovations will help support their goals. In the past, IT teams acted as service centres to develop products on request. However, newer models utilize IT business partners to anticipate proactively a firm’s technology needs and manage the delivery of these IT solutions.

IT business partners will typically hold regular meetings with stakeholders throughout the company to understand the specific goals of the overall business and individual departments. These professionals will then translate those needs into technology requirements for IT development. As a result of this close relationship, IT business partners will also become the main point of contact for the local business and technology teams.

After a new technology is successfully delivered, these professionals will also be responsible for ensuring that end users understand how to use these new tools and resolve any issues they may encounter. Another important task is to relay any feedback to technology teams.

Communication ability is essential for this role as a large part of the job will involve acting as an intermediary between the local business and technology teams. Due to the need to support different departments within a company, employers will typically seek proven industry experts with strong business acumen. As a result, employers will often require specific industry experience. However, we are finding some companies willing to consider professionals from similar industry backgrounds as specialised candidates become shorter in supply.

This role is a ‘dual-hat’ role – it represents the business within technology discussions and vice versa, represents technology in the business discussions.

The AGS Technology Business Partner (India) is responsible for working closely with the Technology and Data strategy teams, the AGS Program Office (PO), the Recruitment Delivery Centre (RDC) and regional senior leadership to successfully sustain, implement and grow the technologies critical to the success of AGS. Key stakeholders will also include regional VPs and Executive Directors.

This position will be recognized as the technical subject matter expert for the application of recruitment technology within AGS services and will analyze reoccurring technology incidents and identifies areas of operational efficiencies for program improvements and growth to provide strategic consultation or resolution to AGS PO, RDC, Clients and Technology Partners.

The role is an AGS Technology strategic position meant to drive significant improvements in AGS account and delivery processes, technology adoption, operations, efficiencies, and profitability.

title: AI Quality Engineer
jobDescription:
About the Role

Testing AI systems is a fundamentally different problem than testing traditional software. Outputs are non-deterministic. "Correct" is often a spectrum. And the failure modes—hallucinations, drift, prompt injection—don't show up in unit tests. We need an engineer who understands this and can build the testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and quality infrastructure to keep our agents reliable in production.

As an AI Quality Engineer, you'll design how we test intelligent agents, agentic workflows, and Foundation Layer capabilities. This is not a manual QA role—you'll write code, build evaluation pipelines, and create automated testing frameworks that run in CI/CD. You'll define what "quality" means for AI systems at AGS and build the systems to measure it.

You'll work across every solution the team builds, which means you'll have broad visibility into the architecture and deep understanding of how our agents behave in the real world. If you're an engineer who cares about quality and wants to solve testing problems that most teams haven't figured out yet, this is the role.

Responsibilities

 

Testing Strategy & Design

  • Define testing strategies for AI agents, conversational interfaces, and agentic workflows
  • Design behavioral test suites for non-deterministic outputs—where "correct" isn't binary
  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure groundedness, factuality, relevance, and task completion
  • Identify failure modes specific to AI systems: hallucinations, prompt injection, context window limitations, drift
  • Develop testing approaches for each architecture pattern: RAG, function calling, human-in-the-loop, autonomous workflows

 

Test Automation & Infrastructure

  • Build automated evaluation pipelines that run as part of CI/CD
  • Create test harnesses for LLM-based systems—mocking, fixtures, and reproducible test scenarios
  • Develop regression suites that detect quality degradation when prompts, models, or data change
  • Build monitoring and alerting for production agent quality (accuracy, latency, error rates)
  • Maintain test infrastructure: test data management, environment setup, reporting dashboards

 

Evaluation & Metrics

  • Define quality metrics for each solution—what to measure and what thresholds matter
  • Build and maintain evaluation datasets (ground truth, reference outputs, edge case collections)
  • Conduct systematic prompt evaluation when prompts or models change
  • Track quality trends over time and identify when re-evaluation is needed
  • Report quality metrics to the team and stakeholders in clear, actionable terms

 

Collaboration & Quality Culture

  • Partner with AI Solutions Engineers to define testability requirements during design
  • Work with AI Solutions Analysts to translate acceptance criteria into test scenarios
  • Review solution designs from a quality and testability perspective
  • Advocate for quality practices across the team—testing isn't an afterthought, it's part of delivery
  • Contribute to incident response by diagnosing quality failures and building regression tests
minimumQualification:
Qualifications

 

Required

  • 3–7 years of software engineering or quality engineering experience
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript—you write test code, not just test cases
  • Experience designing and building automated test frameworks
  • Understanding of AI/ML systems—you know why testing LLM outputs is different from testing deterministic code
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build processes
  • Ability to reason about non-deterministic systems and design meaningful quality metrics
  • Strong analytical skills—you can look at agent outputs and determine whether they're good enough

 

Preferred

  • Experience testing AI/ML applications, conversational interfaces, or chatbots
  • Background in LLM evaluation: prompt testing, groundedness scoring, factuality checking
  • Familiarity with evaluation frameworks (DeepEval, Ragas, custom evaluation pipelines)
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Copilot Studio) testing
  • Background in Azure services and cloud-based test infrastructure
  • Experience with load testing and performance testing for API-based systems
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or workforce management domains

 

Technology Stack

  • Languages: Python, TypeScript
  • Platforms: Azure (Container Apps, Functions, AI Services), Microsoft 365
  • Testing: pytest, evaluation frameworks (DeepEval, Ragas, custom), load testing tools
  • AI/ML: LLM evaluation, prompt testing, RAG evaluation, behavioral testing
  • Data: REST APIs, Dataverse, SQL
  • Tools: Git, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, monitoring/alerting (Application Insights)

We don't expect expertise in everything. AI quality engineering is a new discipline—we expect strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to figure out new problems.

 

What We're NOT Looking For

  • Manual testers who write test cases in spreadsheets
  • QA professionals who treat testing as a gate at the end of development rather than a practice woven into it
  • People who expect deterministic pass/fail for every test—AI quality requires nuance
  • Engineers who test to the spec but don't think about how real users will break things

 

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You've tested a system where "correct" was hard to define—and found a way to measure it anyway
  • You write test code that's as clean and maintainable as production code
  • You think about edge cases that nobody else considers
  • You can explain why a particular quality metric matters and what threshold makes sense
  • You've built test automation that actually caught regressions before they hit production
  • You're comfortable saying "this isn't good enough" and backing it up with data

 

What We're Building

The AI Engineering team delivers intelligent solutions for AGS's global clients:

  • Intelligent Agents — Conversational AI that helps hiring managers, recruiters, and internal teams get work done faster
  • Agentic Workflows — Automated processes where AI executes tasks with human oversight
  • Foundation Capabilities — Reusable AI services that power multiple solutions

You'll make sure these systems work reliably—not just at launch, but as models change, data evolves, and usage scales.

 

Career Growth

AI quality engineering is an emerging discipline with no ceiling. Growth paths include:

  • Depth — Become the team's authority on AI evaluation and testing methodology, influencing quality standards across the organization
  • Breadth — Move into a Senior or Lead AI Solutions Engineer role, bringing your quality mindset to architecture and delivery
  • Specialization — Build expertise in areas like LLM security testing, AI safety, or evaluation research

You're the backbone of delivery. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you'll own complex features end-to-end—from design through production—and produce work that sets the standard for the rest of the team. You'll build intelligent agents, agentic workflows, and Foundation Layer capabilities that multiple solutions depend on.

This role sits between Junior Engineers and the Lead. You deliver independently on hard problems, contribute meaningfully to architecture decisions, and make the engineers around you better through code review and informal mentoring. The Lead sets technical direction; you execute it at a high level and push back when something doesn't make sense.

We expect you to be self-directed. You'll take ambiguous requirements and turn them into working software. You'll make sound trade-off decisions. Design & Deliver

Stakeholder Collaboration

title: AI Solutions Analyst
jobDescription:
The AI Solutions Analyst is the bridge between business needs and technical delivery. You'll take incoming requests for AI agents and automations, document clear requirements, design conversation flows, and ensure the engineering team has everything they need to build the right solution. This role combines business analysis skills with AI literacy and enough technical understanding to communicate effectively with engineers. You'll work with stakeholders to understand what they need, translate that into specifications, and coordinate through delivery and acceptance. If you enjoy understanding problems deeply and setting teams up for success, this role is for you.

 

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Requirements & Analysis

  • Gather and document business requirements for AI agent and automation requests
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications
  • Define acceptance criteria and success metrics
  • Identify data inputs, outputs, and integration requirements
  • Recognize when existing Foundation Layer capabilities can address requirements

Conversation Design

  • Design conversation flows for agents and chatbots
  • Define agent behaviors, personas, and guardrails
  • Map out user journeys and interaction patterns
  • Specify how agents should handle edge cases and errors

Intake & Triage

  • Manage the intake process for new solution requests
  • Triage requests based on complexity, priority, and dependencies
  • Identify opportunities to reuse existing capabilities
  • Coordinate defect routing with QA and engineering teams

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Partner with business users to understand their needs and constraints
  • Facilitate requirements discussions and resolve ambiguities
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) with stakeholders
  • Communicate status updates and manage expectations

Quality & Documentation

  • Support QA by clarifying requirements and expected behaviors
  • Develop test scenarios that reflect real user interactions
  • Maintain documentation for solutions and business processes
  • Contribute to data governance considerations (data quality, access, privacy)

 

What We're Building

The AI Engineering team delivers intelligent solutions for AGS's global clients:

  • Intelligent Agents — Conversational AI that helps hiring managers, recruiters, and internal teams get work done faster
  • Agentic Workflows — Automated processes where AI executes tasks with human oversight
  • Foundation Capabilities — Reusable AI services that power multiple solutions

You'll ensure these solutions are built to solve the right problems—clearly defined, well-understood, and accepted by the business.
minimumQualification:
Required

  • 2-4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, or similar role
  • Proven ability to gather requirements and write clear specifications
  • Experience working with technical teams in an agile environment
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts—you can explain what an LLM does and when to use one
  • Strong communication skills—written and verbal in English
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and stakeholders simultaneously

Preferred

  • Experience designing conversation flows or chatbot interactions
  • Familiarity with low-code platforms (Power Platform, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Background in staffing, HR tech, or workforce management
  • Experience with requirements tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar)
  • Understanding of data flows and integration concepts

 

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You ask the "why" questions that uncover real requirements
  • You can translate business language to technical language (and back)
  • You document clearly—engineers don't have to guess what you meant
  • You think about how users will actually interact with an agent, not just what it should do
  • You manage stakeholders effectively without overpromising
  • You follow through—requests don't fall through the cracks with you

title: Engineering Manager, AI Solutions
jobDescription:
We're building AGS's AI Engineering team from the ground up, and we need a people leader to help us scale. The Engineering Manager, AI Solutions owns team health, delivery capacity, and career development for our India-based engineering team. This is fundamentally a people management role. Technical direction comes from the Head of AI Engineering and the Lead AI Solutions Engineer. Your job is to enable your team to do their best work—hiring great people, removing blockers, developing careers, and building a high-performance engineering culture. You'll manage a team that includes AI Solutions Engineers, AI Quality Engineers, and AI Solutions Analysts—starting with a small team and scaling to 20+. Together, this team builds intelligent agents, conversational interfaces, and reusable AI capabilities for AGS's global clients.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing engineering team (scaling to 20+)
  • Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide coaching, and create growth opportunities
  • Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and engineering excellence
  • Partner with the Lead AI Solutions Engineer to ensure engineers have the technical support they need

Delivery Management

  • Ensure predictable delivery against committed timelines
  • Manage capacity planning, workload distribution, and resource allocation
  • Track team health metrics and drive continuous improvement
  • Remove blockers and escalate issues before they become problems
  • Balance delivery pressure with sustainable pace

Hiring & Team Building

  • Execute our hiring philosophy: hire for software engineering fundamentals, not certifications
  • Build a team with complementary skills across AI/ML, data engineering, platform, and full-stack development
  • Run effective interview processes and make strong hiring decisions
  • Onboard new team members and set them up for success

Stakeholder Coordination

  • Partner with Head of AI Engineering on priorities and roadmap
  • Coordinate with business stakeholders on delivery expectations
  • Communicate team status, risks, and accomplishments to leadership
  • Work across time zones with North America leadership (US Eastern overlap required)

Operational Excellence

  • Establish and refine team processes (agile ceremonies, code review, deployment)
  • Drive adoption of engineering best practices and standards
  • Manage team budget and resource planning
  • Ensure compliance with AGS governance and security requirements

 

The Team You'll Lead

  • AI Solutions Engineers — Build Foundation Layer capabilities (APIs, services) and deliver agent solutions. Career track runs from Engineer → Senior → Lead → Architect. Strong software engineering fundamentals required across all levels.
  • AI Quality Engineers — Design testing strategies for AI systems. Focus on behavioral testing for non-deterministic outputs.
  • AI Solutions Analysts — Bridge business needs and technical implementation. Own requirements, conversation design, and stakeholder coordination.
